newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares, Mosenergo ease, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares, Mosenergo ease, seen down.

text.p: Leading Russian shares including utility Mosenergo slipped in early trade on Friday, and traders said they expected the market to drift lower over the day.

Mosenergo had initially opened higher, building on Thursday's gains, after a company announcement late on Thursday that it would not pursue moves to limit shareholders' voting rights and issue new shares.
"I don't think there will be major price fluctuations today -- perhaps there will even be a further easing," said Alexei Rozhkov, a trader at Regent European Securities.
The Russian Trading System 23-share index opened at 295.80 after closing on Thursday at 298.08.
At 0930 GMT UES edged down to $0.2170 from $0.2185 at Thursday's close, Mosenergo slid to $1.290 from $1.295 but Surgutneftegaz edged up to $0.705 from $0.699.
Traders said Mosenergo had initially risen to $1.320.
"Whatever happens, its good. All those decisions by the board of directors were not doing the market any good," said Andrei Ippolitov, head of trading at Prospekt.
Operators said short covering would likely support Mosenergo prices today and some said they did not rule out a rise in leading share prices overall.
But others said Western demand would probably determine market movements.
"There were some very big Western buyers yesterday but I think most of their orders have already been fulfilled," said Regent's Rozhkov.
